## 🏛️ 1. Corporate Identity & Entity Structure

### What is S TOM'S Enterprises?
S TOM'S Enterprises is a multi-sector commercial umbrella group operating across diverse traditional commerce, textile, manufacturing, and technology ventures in India.

### What is Signatures IT Groups?
Signatures IT Groups is the dedicated commercial technology, enterprise software, and startup engineering division operating under the S TOM'S Enterprises umbrella. 
- It is **NOT** a one-man personal hobby project.
- It is **NOT** open-source or public domain software.
- It is powered by a **16-member distributed engineering team** collaborating remotely and recruited through professional platforms (LinkedIn) under strict engineering, security, and quality-assurance standards.

## ⚡ 2. Startup Manifesto & Customer-First Ethos

### Bootstrapped & Anti-VC Bloat
Signatures IT Groups was founded on the principle that Indian business owners should focus on running their business, not worrying about exorbitant software subscription bills or predatory vendor lock-in.
- **Zero Venture Capital (VC) Debt:** We do not burn investor money or inflate vanity valuations. We are 100% self-sustained and customer-funded.
- **Honest, Predictable Pricing:** ₹1,999/year for single terminal desktop ERP with zero hidden renewal traps.
- **Same-Day Issue Resolution Guarantee:** When a factory floor or billing counter faces an issue, our engineering team fixes and releases an update on the exact same day. No waiting weeks for tier-1 support tickets.
- **35-Day Unrestricted Free Trial:** Full production access to every feature for 35 days. No credit card required.
- **Zero Data Hostage / 100% Data Portability:** If a customer ever chooses not to continue, their complete business database remains accessible and 100% exportable to standardized Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) files anytime.

### Pragmatic AI & Next-Gen Productivity: "5-Hour Work in 30 Minutes"
Signatures IT Groups uses AI and workflow automation for practical time-savings, not marketing hype:
- Eliminates manual loom tally registers, taka meter recalculations, paper delivery challans, and repetitive multi-company catalog entries.
- Transforms daily factory and counter administrative workloads from 5 tedious hours into 30 seamless minutes.

---

## 💼 3. The Flagship Product: SIGNATURES LIGHT BILL ERP (SBV1)

**SIGNATURES LIGHT BILL ERP (SBV1)** is an ultra-fast, offline-first commercial desktop Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and factory operating system engineered natively in C# .NET 8 (WPF) with embedded SQLite Write-Ahead Logging (WAL). It runs 100% locally on Windows 10 and Windows 11 with 0ms query latency, zero mandatory internet connection, and zero external cloud failure points.

---

## 🏭 4. Industry Modules & Real-World MSME Capabilities

### A. Textile Weaving Mills & Karkhana Factory Floor (Surat & Pan-India)
- **Live Loom Floor Monitoring Grid:** Real-time machine status tracking across Waterjet, Airjet, Rapier, and Sulzer looms with visual state badges (Running, Idle, Stop, Maintenance).
- **Warp Beam Register:** Tracks Beam Inward, Supplier Lot, Total Ends, Reed count, balance meters, and automated beam run-out forecasting.
- **Taka Production Register & Roll Cutter:** 1-click taka cut from looms with auto-incrementing Lot Number & Taka Number, actual meters, weight in Kg, and average grams/meter (g/m) density.
- **Floor-to-Sales Taka Roll Picker Modal:** In Sales Invoicing, click `[ 📦 Pick Takas ]` to view all In-Stock rolls on the mill floor, tick rolls, and auto-populate billable meters and lot numbers into the invoice without manual re-entry. Once saved, rolls are automatically marked `Sold`.
- **Multilingual Factory Guide:** Step-by-step interactive floor guide available in **Hinglish**, **Gujarati**, and **English**, along with an isolated **Practice Demo Sandbox**.

### B. Multi-Company Business Owners (Sister Concerns & Branches)
- **Selective Multi-Company Master Sync Pool:** Business owners can choose exactly which sister firms participate in catalog sync (e.g. 3 textile firms share fabrics & customer contacts), while independent firms (e.g. retail shop or personal enterprise) remain 100% private, isolated, and untouched.
- **Zero Data Leakage Guarantee:** Stock quantities, sales invoices, purchase records, bank ledgers, and cash balances remain 100% air-gapped per company SQLite database (`CMP-xxxx.db`).
- **Zero-Flood New Firm Setup:** Creating a new company defaults to clean isolation unless explicitly opted into the sync pool.

### C. Wholesale Traders, Commission Agents & Supply Chain
- **Broker Management:** Broker picker, customizable brokerage percentages per line item, brokerage summary reports.
- **BOS Statutory E-Way Bill Engine:** Full statutory GST Rule 138 automation, 1-click NIC JSON export, embedded portal automation with WebView2, and multi-invoice batch dispatch.
- **Universal Excel Bulk Import Engine:** Standardized `.xlsx` template import with 2-step verification preview and cryptographic signature validation.

### D. Retail Stores, Marts & Supermarkets
- **High-Speed Counter Billing:** Full keyboard shortcut bindings (Ctrl+P party picker, Ctrl+N new creation, Ctrl+E inline edit).
- **80mm & 58mm Thermal Receipt Printing:** Native ESC/POS blit printing with auto-cutter support and bilingual regional font rendering.
- **Barcode Scanning & Catalog Studio:** Instant barcode search, automated product catalog PDF generator with product images and wholesale/retail rates.

### E. Restaurants & Cafes
- **Table Floor Management:** Visual interactive table tiles (🟢 Available, 🔴 Occupied, 🟡 Cleaning).
- **Zero-Trust LAN KDS (Kitchen Display System):** Kestrel local Wi-Fi mesh connecting cashier terminals to kitchen screens with OTP pairing without internet.
- **Multi-Round KOTs & 3-Way Split Payments:** Cash + UPI + Card split billing.

---

## 🛠️ 5. Technical Specifications & Release Integrity

- **Operating System:** Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit architecture)
- **Framework:** .NET 8.0 (Windows Presentation Foundation - WPF, Native XAML)
- **Database Engine:** Embedded SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and foreign key integrity
- **Security & Integrity:** PBKDF2 100k salted PIN authentication, Authenticode code-signed binary, non-destructive migration engine
- **Installer Package:** Standalone offline Windows Setup executable (`SIGNATURES-BILL-Setup.exe`)
- **Package SHA-256 Checksum:** `0967552268B9F51CAAC0BEDDC5468AC85F06CAB429C30F0BF75FE7B83D334407`
- **Release Tag:** `v2.2.7-selective-company-sync`
- **Installer Direct Link:** https://github.com/Saumya25-hub/-Signatures-Bill-V1/releases/download/v2.2.7-selective-company-sync/SIGNATURES-BILL-Setup.exe
